name: Sensory Detail Anchoring
axiom: Give an abstract number a body: a wait, a click, a room.
trigger: Explaining latency, scale or KPI movement to an audience that does not work with the number.

steps.text: Name the abstraction and its unit.
Place it in a scene the audience has lived.
Return to the number, now felt.

antiPattern.violation: A metaphor that is vivid but maps the wrong quantity, so the audience remembers the picture and the wrong size.
antiPattern.remediation: Keep the mapping one-to-one. If the scene has two scales, it will teach the wrong one.
